verdict.rationale: Bugbot's docs say it leaves inline PR comments with explanations and suggested fixes, and provides 'Fix in Cursor' and 'Fix in Web' links that open the issue in the Cursor IDE or cloud agents to apply a fix. Nothing shows those suggestions are rendered as committable suggestion diffs that can be applied with one click inside the PR. missing for 10: documented committable/suggestion-block diffs in review comments, one-click apply/commit within the PR UI, independent or hands-on corroboration of applying suggestions.
